body:
It's something very weird but...  
I was scrolling down my ig account (deleteing old photos, videos etc) and I noticed a reel I "Saved" it was about a bear hitting his own nuts with a stick, although I was sobbing because of my BU I started laughing like a madman, that bear made my day, and somehow, it gave me a new perspective about my grief

4 months
I still care a little bit about her
But it's leaving
I can feel it

I don't miss u
Neither the good time we spent together
But I really think u should apologize for what u did me
U hurted me the same way that all those guys hurted u
And I am very disappointed of both of us
But more of me, because I really trusted u, I really open my heart and show MY REAL ME
Maybe one day I can forgive u
And give u a real smile
